[LADP.5.3.1] Declare the slot `String` and serialise whatever the source
system produced to its string form. `72.1` → `"72.1"`,
`true` → `"true"`, `"on"` → `"on"`. Rules that need numeric
access use `parse_float` / `parse_int` / `parse_bool`
explicitly (or upstream rules that parse and emit a narrower
schema).
